d:
Patna is the principal city and capital of Bihar holding tremendous significance. In ancient times, Patna was known as Pataliputra and served as a hub for politics, commerce, and cultural activities.
So on this episode of India With Elli Season 02 Bihar edition, Elli AvrRam takes you on an exciting tour of Patna, a city rich in culture.
Elli visits some remarkable places in Patna.
Gandhi Setu
Gandhi Khadi Market
Buddha Smriti Park
Champaran Mutton House
Iskon Temple
